$schema_note: Objectives for GARUN's NSGA-II sizing problem. All pymoo objectives are minimized by convention -- endurance is negated (f2 = -endurance_hr) so maximizing endurance becomes minimizing -endurance_hr.

objectives.label: Maximum Take-Off Weight
objectives.notes: Mass-buildup estimate: payload + fuel + battery_mass + engine_mass + motor_mass, divided by (1 - structure_fraction).

objectives.label: Mission fuel burn
objectives.notes: Summed fuel consumption across all 6 mission segments (takeoff, climb, cruise, loiter, descent, land).

objectives.label: Mission endurance
objectives.notes: Dominated primarily by the iteratively-computed loiter duration -- see mission._max_loiter_time().

reference_point_for_hypervolume.notes: Worst-case-ish reference point used by pymoo.indicators.hv.HV in main.py's run_optimization().

reference_target_for_knee_selection.source: Originally submitted proposal figures -- used only as a comparison target in pick_knee_design(), not independently re-derived by this codebase.
